snippet.title: Robotic Space Zamboni - Gameplay (v0.0.2.1)
snippet.description:
Robotic Space Zamboni is a puzzle game where you play as the one and only Robotic Space Zamboni.  Clear the ice and return to where you started, in as few moves as possible.

Free demo available now for Windows and web browsers:
https://snail-dream.itch.io/zamboni

Still in active development.  Thanks for playing!
